typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		paaLastAttestedDateTime as string,
		appId as string,
		paaHostingTypes as string,
		paaLastAttestedBy as string,
		paaPatterns as string,
		pci as string,
		pciPatterns as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> CSVFile
CSVFile derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		appId as string,
		pci as string,
		paaLastAttestedDateTime as string,
		paaLastAttestedBy as string,
		paaPatterns as string,
		pciPatterns as string,
		paaHostingTypes as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		importdate = ImportDate,
		appId,
		pci,
		paaLastAttestedDateTime,
		paaLastAttestedBy,
		paaPatterns,
		pciPatterns,
		paaHostingTypes),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
